title: Surreal Film Reel Dreamscape
description: A large rusty film reel sits atop a colorful swirling platform in a desolate landscape, unspooling film strips with silhouetted figures. To the right stands a bright lime-green dog with ornate patterns on its neck, next to a blue mushroom character wearing a red cap, under a vibrant psychedelic spiral sky.
prompt: surreal desert landscape with a giant rusty film reel spilling old film strips showing black silhouettes, the reel rests on a platform covered in yellow green and blue swirling patterns, to the right a lime green dog with intricate brown patterns on its neck stands looking away, next to it a blue mushroom with a red cap and a smaller yellow mushroom, dramatic colorful concentric circles in purple blue green and pink fill the sky, barren hills in the distance, scattered film reels and papers on the ground, highly detailed symbolic painting
